preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 50,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 500000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of vertices n in each test case is between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid vertices within the range [1, n].
The length of the colors string matches the number of vertices n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'WN' for c in colors)
preconditions.description: Each character in the colors string is either 'W' or 'N'.
There is at least one vertex already colored in white.

postconditions.expression: all(result in ['White', 'Draw', 'Black'] for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is one of 'White', 'Draw', or 'Black'.
The number of results matches the number of test cases T.
